column1: # one row per burst of the leftover tools/mesh_throttle12.sh, read from scrollfiesta-grid-0139/log/grid-armed.txt by tools/throttle_bursts.py. start_utc is the machine before line of the relaunch, end_utc the grid_pipeline rc line that closes it. A row whose grid_pipeline_return_code is empty has no rc line: it was killed by the next relaunch, so its end_utc and wall_seconds are UPPER BOUNDS, not a measured duration. These bursts ran on one core (grid_weld) when every cube was already done, and on up to max_conc cores when they were not.
